ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ቅድመ: ቅድመ — before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
ንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — as for us (1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
ወደቂቆሙ: ደቂቅ — and their children (ወ- + noun, plural + -ሙ '3mp their')
ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ወነሥኡ: ነሥአ — and they took (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ወቦኡ: ቦአ — and they entered (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ቅድስተ: ቅድስት — holy place, sanctuary (noun, fem.; construct 'holy of')
ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ወሶቤሃ: ሶቤሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
በአሐቲ: አሐዱ — with one (በ- + fem. numeral አሐቲ) · 'by one' (በአሐቲ ፍናው 'by one road')
ወፅአ: ወጽአ — he came out (3ms perfect, G; written ወፅአ)
በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘተርፈ: ተረፈ — who remained (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, t-r-f)
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
ለእሉ: እሉ — to these, these (ለ- marking the object + demonstrative, plural)
ወይኩን: ኮነ — and may it be (ወ- 'and' + 3ms jussive, G, k-w-n)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ለክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — of Christ, Christ's (ለ- naming the possessor after an anticipating suffix) · ለ- marking the object, doubled by the suffix on ወያመስልዎ ('they liken Christ')
ዘበ: በ — in, on (preposition; ዘ- 'that which (is)'; spaced off its noun in the edition)
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
ዘርእየ: ርእየ — what he saw (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G) · who saw (ዘ- 'who' relative + 3ms perfect: ዘርእየ ምንዳቤየ 'who saw my distress')
የዐርግ: ዐርገ — he goes up (3ms imperfect, G, ʿ-r-g)
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
ለኃጥኣን: ኃጥእ — the sinners (ለ- marking the object + plural ኃጥኣን)
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
ኀልቁ: ኀልቀ — they came to an end, perished (3m pl perfect)
ወይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — and they said to them (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎሙ 'to them')
ለሙሴ: ሙሴ — to Moses (ለ- + proper name) · ለ- marking the object after an anticipating suffix (ሐመይዎ ለሙሴ 'they slandered Moses')
ወለአሮን: አሮን — and to Aaron (ወ- + ለ- + proper name)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
ለምድር: ምድር — to/for the earth, or earth as object (ለ- + noun) · 'of the earth', ለ- as genitive link (ወእምስፍሓ ለምድር 'and from the breadth of the earth')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ኀብሩ: ኀብረ — they gathered, assembled (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-b-r) · they agreed, conspired (3mp perfect, here of a wicked agreement)
ፈነወ: ፈነወ — he sent (3ms perfect, G, f-n-w)
ወሞቱ: ሞተ — and they died (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, m-w-t)
ቊልዔከ: ቍልዔ — your child, your boy (noun + -ከ '2ms your'; in apposition to Isaac)
ቅዱስከ: ቅዱስ — your holy one (adjective as noun + -ከ '2ms your'; in apposition to Israel)
ዘርኦሙ: ዘርእ — their seed (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; anticipating ለአበዊነ)
ውሉደ: ወልድ — sons, children (plural ውሉድ, accusative) · construct 'sons of' (ምሕረተ ውሉደ ሰብእ 'the mercy toward the sons of men', ch. 95)
መሓሪ: መሓሪ — merciful (active participle, agent noun of ምሕረ, m-ḥ-r)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ለዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — to this one (ለ- + m. demonstrative) · ለ- marking the object, repeating the suffix on the verb (ለዝንቱ ወሬዛ, ለዝንቱ ሕፃን 'this lad, this child')
ወበሎሙ: ብህለ — and say to them (ወ- + imperative በል of ብህለ, ይቤ 'say' + -ሙ 'them')
ወአምጽኡ: አምጽአ — and they brought (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of መጽአ)
በትረ: በትር — rod, staff (construct 'rod of') · also accusative 'rod(s)' after a number (ሠለስተ በትረ 'three rods')
እኁከ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ከ 'your', 2ms)
ለደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — to the children of (construct) · 'of the children of' (ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix: ሐሜቶሙ ለደቂቀ እስራኤል 'the murmuring of the children of Israel') · ለ- marking the object after an anticipating suffix (አመንደብዎሙ አክይስት ለደቂቀ እስራኤል 'serpents afflicted the children of Israel')
ወለኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and to all of them (ወ- + ለ- 'to' + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp them')
እምትካት: ትካት — from the foundation, from of old (?) (እም- 'from' + ትካት 'establishment', cf. ዘትካት in ch. 30; sense uncertain) (?)
መንክር: መንክር — wonder, marvel; wondrous (noun/adj.; here 'of wonder')
በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)
ለቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ለ- + noun, construct) · 'to, for the house of' (ይሠውዕ ለቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'he offers sacrifice to the house of God')
አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
